title: Craft hovering in S4 hangars

tellings.quote: So they actually went all the way to S4 uh and went down in the big elevators and went in and he said he saw like three or four.

plain: Visitors are said to have gone all the way into S4, a secret site near Area 51 in Nevada, ridden down in big elevators, and seen three or four craft hovering inside the hangars. The lawyer Dan Sheehan relays this second-hand, tying it to a man named Oscar Wolf and to Bob Lazar and Dan Burisch, two men who have each made claims about the site. If true, unexplained craft would be kept under the Nevada desert.
